package.name: rammp_ui_bridge_streaming
package.description: C++ RMSS camera-streaming node for rammp_ui_bridge: forwards the scene camera's raw color/depth frames and the engine-overlay camera's frames (docs/NODE_INTERFACE.md §5.2.A) to UE's RMSS streaming server, as an independent replacement for ui_bridge_node's own Python-side forwarding (see that node's "use_python_camera_streaming" param, which also makes it stop touching camera topics at all in this configuration). This node is its own arbitration server for the overlay camera -- it hosts its own rammp_common_interfaces ~/acquire_control / ~/release_control (the Orchestrator pushes it the same per-execution session token it pushes to ui_bridge_node's ui_control) and subscribes directly to the raw engine_overlay_topic, independent of and parallel to ui_bridge_node. Wire-compatible byte-for-byte with ramms_tools.streaming.StreamSender -- this package re-implements that one client-side class in C++.
